PaneMenu.note: Five items composed inside a popover surface: icons in the reserved slot, left-aligned truncating labels, and a destructive-tinted Close pane row. Correct 8px min-height rows.

WithTrailing.note: trailing slot exercised with ShortcutBadge and a plain value ('On'); trailing content sits right-aligned in the muted role.

IconSlotAlignment.note: reserveIconSlot is the real axis here — the left menu keeps labels aligned past an empty icon slot, the right one has no slot at all. The difference is clearly legible.

Disabled.note: Disabled rows render at reduced opacity with the hover suppressed, next to an enabled row for contrast.
